figurative_meaning_bn: বড় বড় হামাগুড়ি; দুইহাতের করতল ও পদতলের উপর ভর করে হাঁটা
figurative_meaning_en: Crawling with large strides; walking while bearing weight on the palms of the hands and soles of the feet
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে বাঘাহামা করে নদীর তীর দিয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The child is crawling on all fours around the room.
He went across the riverbank crawling like a tiger.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of animal-like movement, common in rural Bengali expressions.
